original.target_description: Within-participant effect of 90 minutes AX-CPT versus neutral documentaries on cycling time to exhaustion at 80% peak power output; Hills-Harmitage condition comparison.

n.location: p. 860 (PDF p. 4), Effect of Mental Fatigue on Exercise Tolerance
n.quote: Individual time to exhaustion was shorter in the mental fatigue condition in 13 of 16 subjects.
n.sample_role: Participants in the randomized crossover cycling experiment; each contributed both treatment conditions.
n.exclusions: Sixteen eligible subjects; no post-enrolment exclusions or outcome-specific missing observations reported.

es.location: p. 860 (PDF p. 4), Effect of Mental Fatigue on Exercise Tolerance

p.location: p. 860 (PDF p. 4), Effect of Mental Fatigue on Exercise Tolerance
p.quote: Time to exhaustion was significantly lower in the mental fatigue condition (640 ⫾ 316 s) compared with control (754 ⫾ 339 s) (P ⫽ 0.003)

replication.target_description: Primary within-participant comparison of cycling time to exhaustion following AX-CPT versus documentaries, using the one-sided Bayes factor; final sample of 30.

n.location: p. 4, Participants; p. 3, sequential stopping rule
n.quote: A final sample of 30 (24 males, 6 females) participants with an age 23.5 ± 6.3 years, VO2Max 41.88 ± 9.08 mil/min/kg, completed the study.
n.sample_role: Final participants completing the within-participant study and primary time-to-exhaustion comparison.
n.exclusions: Eligibility exclusions described on p. 3; no post-recruitment exclusions or primary-outcome missingness reported.

es.quote: The one-sided Bayes factor for the time-to-exhaustion (Fig.2) measure was BF01 = 9.762

reported_success.quote: Our results are in contrast with those of Marcora et al. (2009)

notes: Titles verified against both supplied references. No Cohen d or standardized effect size is printed for the original target test; condition means and SDs are not converted. The replication prints a one-sided BF01 rather than d and reports no frequentist p for this test. The supplied neutral description identifies the primary physical-performance comparison; locators are empty.
